newsitem.title: JAPAN: NEC wins A$19 mln Australia supercomputer order.
newsitem.headline: NEC wins A$19 mln Australia supercomputer order.

text.p: NEC Corp said on Wednesday its Australian unit had won an order to supply a supercomputer to Australia's Bureau of Meteorology and the Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation.
The supercomputer order, worth about A$19 million, is the first NEC has won from Australia, an NEC spokesman said.
The system, to be shared by the two organisations, will be used for sophisticated weather and climate forecasting and advanced scientific research, the spokesman said.
The system will begin operating in September, he said.
It will initially run at 64 gigaflops or 64 billion calculations per second, and eventually run at 104 gigaflops, or 104 billion calculations per second, the spokesman said.
